newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Isbank to sell textile unit.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Isbank to sell textile unit.

text.p: T.Is Bankasi, one of Turkey's leading commercial banks, said it reached an agreement with a local group to sell its 80 percent stake in textile subsidiary Guney Sanayi for 60.4 million marks.
In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, Isbank said the executive board's final decision was awaited for the sale deal with Baser Holding to proceed.
It said 32.21 million marks would be received in cash and the remaining 28.19 million marks in seven installments between the years 1997-2003.
About two trillion lira worth shares in Guney Sanayi's 2.5 trillion lira capital will be sold to Baser Holding.

Isbank also said it would purchase 93.3 billion lira nominal-valued Isbank shares currenty in Guney Sanayi's share portfolio for a total of 139.1 billion lira. The bank holds equity stakes in about 50 industrial and finance companies.
